answer.rationale: Negotiating with the incumbent using the low-cost vendor's competitive quote as leverage offers the highest probability of achieving the mandated 18% cost reduction without increasing delivery risk. Memory_c1 validates the stability and zero-disruption value of the current relationship, while memory_c4 confirms the incumbent's historical responsiveness to market benchmarking. Switching vendors (memory_c2) is rejected because the 94% line utilization with no buffer makes any supply transition unacceptably risky, violating the 'no increased delivery risk' constraint. The negotiation preserves the existing stable supply chain while targeting the cost mandate.
